messages:
maya: Morning — heads up, nightly RAG eval picked up a big hit on prompt_set_B. Exact-match down 12% vs last night. reranker/topk ordering totally flipped for ~300 queries.

alex_chen: oof. did the CI run new reranker? any recent merges to rm-service?

evalbot: [nightly-eval] job_id: job_2026_03_20_02
summary: recall -8.2%, nDCG -6.1%, top1-flip-count: 312
artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/tests/job_2026_03_20_02/summary.json

chris_rao: we rolled q4-embed-quant and rm-v3-serve: quantized-reranker last night at ~01:15 UTC. that matches timeline.

sasha_k: quick hypothesis: quantized reranker logits compressed -> ties around topk -> fallback picks different doc ids. also index was rebuilt overnight due to ingest. could be embedding shift + rerank quant.

maya: can someone run the per-query diff for top1 between baseline (yesterday) and today and dump examples of 'good->bad'?

alex_chen: running small script now: `python tools/rerank_diff.py --baselines s3://evals/2026-03-19 --current s3://evals/2026-03-20 --topk 5 --out /tmp/diff.json`

alex_chen: pasted a couple of samples (sanitized):
```
query_id: q_10234
baseline_top1: doc_7 (score 4.12)
current_top1: doc_42 (score 3.98)
reranker_scores_baseline: [4.12,3.91,3.50,3.10]
reranker_scores_current: [3.98,3.97,3.95,3.90]
notes: score compression, closer margins
```

sasha_k: hmm see `scores_current` are tightly packed. that's consistent with quantization introducing rounding. but also check embeddings: did doc vectors shift? run `topk_ids` compare.

alex_chen: topk ids diff shows ~2.6% of topk changed purely from retriever side — index rebuild uses new embed model v2.1. but 8% of flips only appear post-rerank.

chris_rao: so two contributors: index/embed drift + reranker quantization. remediation plan: rollback reranker quant for a canary and compare. also run rerank in float32 path for a sample batch to confirm.

maya: agree. roll back quant on dedicate canary and re-run nightly subset. @sasha_k can you coordinate with infra to pin index to yesterday's shards for comparison?

sasha_k: on it. creating infra ticket: INF-2891. will pin and share test endpoint by 03:45 UTC.

alex_chen: I'm prepping a small eval that forces reranker to use float path: `RERANK_FORCE_FP32=1 pytest tests/it/rerank_smoke.py -k 'sampleflip'` — will run once canary up.

evalbot: canary-run scheduled: job_id canary_2026_03_20_03. will post results.

maya: thanks. if float32 restores quality, we either need narrower quantization scheme or KV-cache-aware calibration. also add more eval prompts focusing on tie-breakers.

chris_rao: add note: if embedding drift + quant both necessary, prioritize pinning index for customers on stable channel and revert quant in prod until we have recalibration.

sasha_k: INF-2891: pinned yesterday shards to canary endpoint at https://canary-index.redwood/internal/ (expires in 4h)

alex_chen: canary float run results: top1-flips dropped from 312 -> 28 on sample 2k queries. float path restores almost all. uploading diff: s3://evals/canary_float_2026-03-20/diff.json

maya: great. rollback quantized reranker in staged today. also schedule a quant-recalibration task: QCAL-47. owner: chris_rao.

chris_rao: noted. i'll run calibration sweep: 100k samples, per-layer dynamic range + asymmetric quant. aim to have candidate by EOD.

maya: thanks team. postmortem draft when we have final numbers. marking as triage-resolved for now. :thumbsup:

evalbot: [job finished] canary_2026_03_20_03 result: nDCG delta -0.2% (within noise), top1-flip 28
